caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet sitting on a rectangular white block. The puppet has a pale grayish face with exaggerated facial features, including red markings on its cheeks and above its eyes, black eyebrows, red lips, and black outlining around the eyes. The hair is depicted as a yellow, textured mass on both sides of the head. Strings are attached to the head and shoulders, indicating its function as a marionette. The puppet is dressed in a loose, harlequin-style costume with a large collar, combining sections of orange-yellow and purple fabric. The gloves and boots of the puppet are colored in muted shades of grayish green. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or elements.
title: Marionette Clown
